Name: ongem-web-security-headers
Comment: ongem-web behind CloudFront (WEB-SEC-05). script-src and connect-src carry the Frontend API host of every Clerk customer instance the build may use: clerk.ongem.com and the OnGem Founder development instance, plus Clerk's bot protection (script from cdn.protect.clerk.com, probes to *.protect.clerk.com) used on sign-up, and the UAE dev API (ADR-0050), which the UAE build calls directly. The card widgets (docs/synctera/cards.md s6) load from the bank's asset hosts (script-src, frame-src) and call its API (connect-src), production and sandbox.

ContentSecurityPolicy.ContentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://clerk.ongem.com https://obliging-hermit-8825.clerk.accounts.dev https://cdn.protect.clerk.com https://challenges.cloudflare.com https://assets.synctera.com https://assets-sandbox.synctera.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://img.clerk.com; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://api-dev.ae.platform.ongem.com https://clerk.ongem.com https://obliging-hermit-8825.clerk.accounts.dev https://*.protect.clerk.com https://assets.synctera.com https://assets-sandbox.synctera.com https://api.synctera.com https://api-sandbox.synctera.com; frame-src https://challenges.cloudflare.com https://assets.synctera.com https://assets-sandbox.synctera.com; worker-src 'self' blob:; manifest-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

Items.Value: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()
